expectations.text: Reports results to leadership in commission-loss dollars saved and recovered rather than in vague risk language
expectations.evidence: The recommended VP message is framed entirely in non-financial metrics: 'coverage against N known fraud typologies', 'a synthetic test suite', 'a false-positive rate', 'precision on live flags', 'X of Y known typologies covered', '92% of flags upheld on manual review'. The only monetary-adjacent mention is a single unexplained item in a list of leading indicators — 'flagged GMV' — with no translation into commission dollars at risk, saved, or recovered, no mention of payout holds/clawbacks, and no guidance to quantify the program's value in money.
